mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace my stairs if they are significantly damaged?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace significantly damaged stairs depends on the extent of structural damage, the cost-effectiveness of repair versus replacement, and your aesthetic goals. Minor issues often warrant repair, while widespread structural failure, severe wood rot, or a desire for a completely new look might lean towards replacement. Hometelligent Inc. can assess the condition of your stairs and provide an objective recommendation based on long-term safety and value, outlining the practical tradeoffs of each option.
